summary: Lists the state of standardization of Internet protocols as determined by the Internet Architecture Board. These periodic snapshots helped people see which protocols were standards. This edition is historic and was replaced by RFC 1880.

eli5.summary: A report card showing which Internet rules are official, which are drafts, and which are just ideas. It was replaced by a newer one.

what is the internet official protocol standards list
